name: @mgread-plugin/rehanman-com
description: MgRead source for public Rehanman webtoons.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/contract.test.mjs test/source.test.mjs
scripts.pack:plugin: npm run build && node tools/mgread.mjs pack

mgread.description: Rehanman 是网络漫画阅读网站，最新列表展示漫画作品。可搜索漫画名称、查看作品介绍与章节目录，并按章节阅读图片。
